description: Default model order for free dispatch offloading (bin/free-agent-tool.py). The first AVAILABLE entry is used; a failed dispatch falls over to the next. Remote entries need ~/.api_keys/<provider>; local entries need their weights on disk. Override the whole list with config/dispatch-preferences.local.json (gitignored) or FA_DISPATCH_PREFS=<path>. Every entry needs family and roles (tests enforce it). An entry with smoke_tested=false is skipped until a smoke test passes, unless FA_DISPATCH_INCLUDE_UNTESTED=1. A request may name a "role" (operator, reasoner, validator, utility): only entries listing that role run, in this order. "avoid_family" skips a model family, so an adversarial review comes from a different family than the work it reviews: a different family often finds what a stronger same-family model misses.
maintainer_note: A-tier roster set by the free-agents maintainer, 2026-10-21, in order: Gemini 3.8 Flash, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (NVIDIA), GLM 5.3, GLM 5.3 Flash, Nemotron 3 Ultra (fallback), then local DeepSeek V4 Flash, Laguna S, KAT Coder (fast, smaller: less sophisticated on hard tasks). Roles (maintainer-approved draft, 2026-10-21) say what each model is strong at; cross-family review is preferred over raw capability for adversarial checks. Kimi K3 was on the list but is NOT included: smoke-tested 2026-10-21, NVIDIA returns 410 Gone (end of life 2026-10-15) and Hugging Face, SiliconFlow, LLM7 and Kilo all answer 402 (paid credits required). NVIDIA was heavily restricted on 2026-10-21; re-evaluate this roster in a future update. The roster will change: add or remove entries here, keeping family and roles set. GLM 5.3 (full) will be deprecated by NVIDIA soon; GLM 5.3 Flash is expected to stay. Other NVIDIA models may deserve a place here: investigate in a future update.

order.note: Strong all-rounder; fast. Free quota runs out fast in a full session, so use it for dispatch.
Thorough analysis and review; slow per request (minutes), too slow for a full session.
Deep-work lane: about a minute before the first token, excellent quality. NVIDIA is deprecating it soon; usable for now. GLM 5.3 Flash stays.
Fast thinking model; the full-session workhorse.
Fallback when the others are unavailable.
Private (never leaves the machine). Very slow in a full session; dispatch is more feasible.
Laguna S 2.1, local: stronger than Laguna XS. Private; strong coder. (NVIDIA's Laguna XS is local-capable and deliberately NOT on this roster: NVIDIA has stronger models.)
Private and very fast; smaller, so weaker on hard tasks: bulk and mechanical work.

session_fallbacks.description: Fallback chain for a FREE SESSION's proxy (bin/remote-session.sh), used when the session's own model is throttled upstream: the proxy answers from the next model here, same port, no restart. Same provider only (a session would drain another provider's free quota). The session's own model is skipped. LA_REMOTE_FALLBACKS=off disables; LA_REMOTE_FALLBACKS=provider:model,... overrides.
session_fallbacks.maintainer_note: Order set 2026-10-21: GLM 5.3 Flash, GLM 5.3, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash (slow but superior quality, so above Nemotron), Nemotron 3 Ultra last (least capable, least likely to be throttled).
